question: Can the mirage of sense-objects delude one who rejoices in the self?
premises: One may be established in rejoicing in one's own self.
Sense-objects can appear as a deceptive mirage.
A deceptive mirage has the power to cause delusion.
inference: Therefore, the mirage of sense-objects deludes even one who rejoices in the self.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of svātmārāmam as object is inferred from context and case ending.
plain_english: The mirage of sense-objects deludes one who rejoices in his own self.
